commands.title: See account data
commands.description: Show data of a customers account
commands.sql:
SELECT cu.customer_ID, cu.firstName, cu.lastName, cu.phoneNumber, cu.email, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district, ad.streetAddress
FROM customer cu
INNER JOIN [address] ad ON cu.address_ID = ad.address_ID

subSql.title: Update customer profile
subSql.sql:
UPDATE customer
SET firstName = @firstName,
	lastName = @lastName,
	phoneNumber = @phoneNumber,
	email = @email
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID;
UPDATE [address]
SET country = @country,
	city = @city,
	district = @district,
	streetAddress = @streetAddress
WHERE address_ID = (
	SELECT TOP 1 address_ID 
	FROM customer
	WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID
)

subSql.title: Delete customer profile
subSql.sql:
DELETE FROM customer
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID

subSql.title: Personal reservations
subSql.sql:
SELECT re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests,
	CASE re.[status]
		WHEN 'P' THEN 'Payed' 
		WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled' 
		WHEN 'R' THEN 'Reserved' 
		ELSE 'Invalid Status'
	END AS [status], 
	COALESCE(ho.hotelName, '') AS hotelName, 
	COUNT(rr.roomNumber) AS reserved_rooms
FROM reservation re
LEFT OUTER JOIN room_reservation rr ON re.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN hotel ho ON rr.hotel_ID = ho.hotel_ID
WHERE customer_ID = @customer_ID
GROUP BY re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests, [status], ho.hotelName
ORDER BY re.checkin ASC

subSql.title: Cancel reservation
subSql.sql:
UPDATE reservation
SET [status] = 'C'
WHERE reservation_ID = @reservation_ID
	AND [status] = 'R'

commands.title: Search hotel
commands.description: Search for an available hotel by location, time period and number of guests
commands.sql:
SELECT ho.hotel_ID, ho.hotelName, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district, MIN(rc.price) AS min_price
FROM roomCategory rc
INNER JOIN hotel ho ON rc.hotel_ID = ho.hotel_ID
INNER JOIN [address] ad ON ho.address_ID = ad.address_ID
WHERE ho.hotel_ID IN (
	SELECT hotel_ID 
	FROM room
	EXCEPT (
		SELECT rr.hotel_ID 
		FROM room_reservation rr
		INNER JOIN reservation re ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
		WHERE re.[status] IN ('R', 'P')
			AND re.checkin < @checkout
			AND re.checkout > @checkin
		)
	)
	AND ad.city LIKE '%' + @city + '%'
	AND ad.district LIKE '%' + @district + '%'
	AND rc.maxGuests >= @guests
GROUP BY ho.hotel_ID, ho.hotelName, ad.country, ad.city, ad.district
ORDER BY min_price ASC

subSql.title: Get available room categories
subSql.sql:
WITH RoomCategoryEquipment AS (
	SELECT rc.roomCategory_ID, STRING_AGG(eq.equipmentTitle, ', ') AS equipment
	FROM equipment eq
	INNER JOIN roomCategory_equipment rce ON rce.equipment_ID = eq.equipment_ID
	INNER JOIN roomCategory rc ON rc.roomCategory_ID = rce.roomCategory_ID
	GROUP BY rc.roomCategory_ID
)
SELECT rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle, rc.maxGuests, CONCAT(rc.price, '€') AS price, CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²') AS [size], rce.equipment, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.roomNumber) AS available_rooms
FROM roomCategory rc
LEFT OUTER JOIN RoomCategoryEquipment rce ON rce.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
INNER JOIN room ro ON ro.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.roomNumber = rr.roomNumber
	AND rr.hotel_ID = ro.hotel_ID
INNER JOIN reservation re ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
WHERE re.reservation_ID NOT IN (
	SELECT reservation_ID
	FROM reservation
	WHERE [status] IN ('R', 'P')
		AND checkin  < @checkout
		AND checkout > @checkin
	)
	AND rc.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
	AND rc.maxGuests >= @guests 
GROUP BY rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle, rc.maxGuests, CONCAT(rc.price, '€'), CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²'), rce.equipment;

subSql.title: Room categories
subSql.sql:
SELECT rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle AS category, rc.maxGuests, CONCAT(rc.price, '€') AS price, CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²') AS [size], COUNT(DISTINCT ro.roomNumber) AS room_count
FROM roomCategory rc
LEFT OUTER JOIN room ro ON ro.roomCategory_ID = rc.roomCategory_ID
WHERE rc.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
GROUP BY rc.roomCategory_ID, rc.categoryTitle, rc.maxGuests, CONCAT(rc.price, '€'), CONCAT(rc.[size], 'm²');

subSql.title: Delete booking option
Reservations
subSql.sql:
SELECT re.reservation_ID, re.checkin, re.checkout, re.guests, dbo.FN_STATUS_DETAILS(re.[status]) AS [status], dbo.FN_FULL_NAME(cu.firstName, cu.lastName) AS fullName, cu.phoneNumber, cu.email,
	CASE
		WHEN re.checkin > GETDATE() THEN 'Upcoming'
		WHEN re.checkout > GETDATE() THEN 'Current'
		WHEN re.checkout < GETDATE() THEN 'Former'
		ELSE 'Invalid'
	END AS reservation_category
FROM reservation re
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_ID = re.customer_ID
WHERE rr.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
ORDER BY re.checkout DESC;

subSql.title: Create invoice
subSql.sql:
INSERT INTO invoice (reservation_ID, address_ID)
VALUES (@reservation_ID,(SELECT TOP 1 address_ID FROM customer WHERE customer_ID = (SELECT TOP 1 customer_ID FROM reservation WHERE reservation_ID = @reservation_ID)));

commands.title: Ranking: hotel total earnings
commands.description: Ranking of all hotels by their total earnings
commands.sql:
SELECT ho.hotelName, SUM(iv.totalPrice) AS total_earnings,
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(iv.totalPrice) DESC) AS [row_number],
	DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(iv.totalPrice) DESC) AS hotel_earnings_dense_rank
FROM invoice iv
INNER JOIN reservation re ON re.reservation_ID = iv.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON rr.reservation_ID = re.reservation_ID
INNER JOIN hotel ho ON ho.hotel_ID = rr.hotel_ID
GROUP BY ho.hotelName

commands.title: Yearly earnings
commands.description: Earnings for specific hotel per year
commands.sql:
SELECT YEAR(iv.invoiceDate) AS [year], SUM(iv.totalPrice) AS earnings
FROM invoice iv
INNER JOIN room_reservation rr ON iv.reservation_ID = rr.reservation_ID
WHERE rr.hotel_ID = @hotel_ID
GROUP BY YEAR(iv.invoiceDate)

commands.title: Never booked rooms
commands.description: Find rooms which where never booked
commands.sql:
SELECT hotel_id, roomNumber
FROM room
EXCEPT (
	SELECT hotel_ID, roomNumber
	FROM room_reservation
)
